FLAGELLANT-PAIN_BOX.title: Pain Box
FLAGELLANT-PAIN_BOX.description: Whenever you take a [red]Deathblow[/red] in combat, gain [gold]Doom[/gold] equal to damage instead.
FLAGELLANT-DARK_IMPULSE.title: Dark Impulse
FLAGELLANT-DARK_IMPULSE.flavor: [red]Embracing the dark to serve the light.[/red]
FLAGELLANT-DARK_IMPULSE.description: Whenever you take a [red]Deathblow[/red] in combat, gain [gold]Doom[/gold] equal to damage instead. At the start of each combat, gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Stress[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-DEATHS_HEAD.title: Death's Head
FLAGELLANT-DEATHS_HEAD.description: When your HP would be reduced to [blue]0[/blue], heal to [green]{Heal}%[/green] of your Max HP instead (works once).
FLAGELLANT-BARRISTANS_HEAD.title: Barristan's Head
FLAGELLANT-BARRISTANS_HEAD.description: At the end of your turn, gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to your [gold]Stress[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-DISMASS_HEAD.title: Dismas's Head
FLAGELLANT-DISMASS_HEAD.flavor: [red]Unfortunately, he will never get a second chance.[/red]
FLAGELLANT-JUNIAS_HEAD.title: Junia's Head
FLAGELLANT-JUNIAS_HEAD.description: Whenever you heal HP in combat, heal [blue]1[/blue] additional HP.
FLAGELLANT-THRILLING_TABLET.title: Thrilling Tablet
FLAGELLANT-THRILLING_TABLET.flavor: [red]Cold allies turn into warm max HP.[/red]
FLAGELLANT-THRILLING_TABLET.description: Upon pickup, double your Max HP and heal all of your HP.
FLAGELLANT-EMANCIPATION.title: Emancipation
FLAGELLANT-EMANCIPATION.description: If your HP is [green]{LowHealthPercent}%[/green] or less, deal [blue]{AdditionalDamagePercent}%[/blue] additional attack damage.
FLAGELLANT-SEARING_SCRIPTURE.title: Searing Scripture
FLAGELLANT-SEARING_SCRIPTURE.description: The first Attack card you play each combat applies [gold]Combo[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-HIS_PRISON.title: His Prison
FLAGELLANT-HIS_PRISON.flavor: [red]A soul that pursues pain, trapped in an undying shell.[/red]
FLAGELLANT-HIS_PRISON.description: Whenever you are hit by an attack, apply [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to the attacker.
